title: MASTER OEM MANUFACTURING AND SUPPLY AGREEMENT

clauses.title: 1. PURCHASE ORDERS AND DELIVERY LEAD TIMES
clauses.text: 1. PURCHASE ORDERS AND DELIVERY LEAD TIMES. Supplier shall manufacture and deliver component units within forty-five (45) days of purchase order receipt.

clauses.title: 2. PRODUCT WARRANTY AND DEFECT REMEDIES
clauses.text: 2. PRODUCT WARRANTY AND DEFECT REMEDIES. Supplier warrants all delivered hardware against manufacturing defects for twenty-four (24) months from delivery date.

clauses.title: 3. PRODUCT DEFECT INDEMNITY
clauses.text: 3. PRODUCT DEFECT INDEMNITY. Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless Buyer and its customers from all third-party product liability claims arising from defective goods.

clauses.title: 4. EXCLUSIVE SUPPLY AND MINIMUM COMMITMENT
clauses.text: 4. EXCLUSIVE SUPPLY AND MINIMUM COMMITMENT. Buyer commits to purchase a minimum volume of 50,000 units annually during the initial three (3) year term.
